title: Teacher-Controlled Course Design Studio

ciFast.note: Remote exact-commit verification begins after this locally verified candidate is pushed.

ciDeep.note: Broader course and independent-instructor evaluation remains separate research evidence.

deploy.note: Production deployment is downstream of push and remote verification.

liveProvider.note: The browser workflow was exercised locally; no deployed-build claim is made.

manualHuman.note: No instructor evaluation, accessibility certification, or classroom validation is claimed.

claims.summary: Full-package drafting pauses at a teacher-visible instructional blueprint review.
Exact plan and Course Map receipts govern every package-drafting entry point and persisted lineage.
Meaning-changing Agent proposals carry one bounded preview, approval, verification, and undo envelope.
Stop genuinely cancels browser-local model preparation and supports an honest clean retry.

boundaries: This is a locally verified predeploy candidate; remote CI and production deployment are downstream facts.
Blueprint approval authorizes bounded drafting but does not certify factual accuracy, sources, accessibility, or classroom outcomes.
The browser record proves the tested workflow and does not prove every browser, storage condition, or device can run the local model.
Automated conformance, immutable receipts, and a held-out benchmark do not substitute for instructor or classroom evaluation.
